sources.title: Sleep quality and memory consolidation in adult learners
sources.abstract: Consistent sleep quality was associated with stronger memory consolidation after learning. The study used repeated recall testing and controlled for baseline performance.

sources.title: Sleep quality and memory consolidation in adults
sources.abstract: Duplicate record for the same sleep and memory source.

sources.title: Targeted sleep interventions and delayed recall
sources.abstract: A randomized sleep hygiene intervention improved delayed recall in students, although effects were smaller for participants with irregular schedules.

sources.title: Mobile notification color and purchase intent
sources.abstract: Notification color changed click behavior in a retail app. The study did not measure sleep, learning, recall, or memory.
